parameter_semantics: drawer_origin_world_m is the world position in metres of the drawer at drawer_position=0 and drawer_orientation_wxyz is its unit wxyz calibration; both construct TCP-relative causal features. desired_open_position_m is intended scalar opening in metres, bound to 0.300 m. Learned increments are policy outputs, never caller actuator inputs.
output_semantics: Each slot is the local SE(3) transform from that slot's measured pre-action TCP to the demonstrated commanded TCP: local translation [3] in metres, local rotation vector [3] in radians, and native gripper scalar [1]. Slots 1..8 execute t..t+7. At every physical step, the slot transform is composed on the fresh measured world TCP pose. The resulting world target is passed to panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh qpos; the gripper scalar is appended unchanged and interpreted by common sign semantics.

conversion_check.description: Local transform encode/decode reconstructs demonstrated commanded TCP targets when composed with the corresponding measured pre-action TCP. Shared IK is evaluated by FK position/rotation and unchanged gripper scalar.

cut_relation: Supervises every action in all assigned [0,470) segments and preserves approach, pull, release, retreat, red pickup and initial lift. The full 230:470 action overlap with red_transfer remains duplicated supervision.
